primaryWitnessChecks.text: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

primaryWitnessChecks.text: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.
Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
primaryWitnessChecks.factTextJa: 12:26では、ヨアブがラバと戦い、王都を取ったと記されます。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.
primaryWitnessChecks.factTextJa: 12:27でヨアブはラバとの戦いと「水の町」を取ったことをダビデに報告します。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.
primaryWitnessChecks.factTextJa: ダビデは軍を集めてラバへ行き、町を攻め取ったと記されます。
